THE_CRITERION.units_correction: The predeclared floor 1.26775e-4 is a scatter in dev = |ratio/R − 1|, NOT in the fold-forward ratio itself. Confirmed by reproducing it: nominal dev 3.5608971051e-2 − floor dev 3.5482196332e-2 = 1.267747e-4. Session A first computed the spread in ratio-space and corrected before adjudicating.
THE_CRITERION.instrument: the repo's own pet_diagnostic_quarantine.measured_fold_forward_dev, which recomputes from the artifact and takes R from each artifact's own target.step1_class_ratio
THE_CRITERION.BRANCH: PASS by the letter of the predeclaration — all five complete, all realized seeds persisted and confirmed, and the member-to-member spread (2.272e-1) exceeds the floor (1.268e-4) by 1792x.

FINDING_1_THE_FLOOR_IS_WITHIN_PROCESS_AN.what: Member 1 carries the promoted nominal's OWN seeds (42,0) by design, so it is a same-seed repeat of the nominal. Every confound was checked and eliminated: same driver (5fda80df — the driver at commit 54a8797, in force when the nominal ran on 2026-08-10, hashes byte-identically to what members 1-4 ran), same inputs_sha256, and a realized seed_policy with ZERO differences from the nominal's (niter 3, epochs 8, train_events 2000000, batch_size 512, identical lr_policy). It differs only in job, node and process.
FINDING_1_THE_FLOOR_IS_WITHIN_PROCESS_AN.measured: member 1 dev 1.9310e-2 against nominal dev 3.5609e-2 — a difference of 1.629870e-2, which is 129x the predeclared floor.
FINDING_1_THE_FLOOR_IS_WITHIN_PROCESS_AN.why_it_matters: The nominal and floor artifacts were both produced by ONE job (56563761, 14:59:48Z–21:00:24Z), which wrote the nominal npz at 18:00:43Z and the floor npz at 21:00:17Z — two sequential trainings in one process. So 1.26775e-4 is a WITHIN-PROCESS repeat scatter. The five members are separate jobs on separate nodes. Comparing across-process spread against within-process scatter is not like-for-like, and it inflates the apparent margin.
FINDING_1_THE_FLOOR_IS_WITHIN_PROCESS_AN.the_honest_margin: Against the across-process floor member 1 itself measures (1.630e-2), the member spread is 13.9x rather than 1792x. The ensemble still resolves estimator variation; the margin is ~129x smaller than the naive reading.
FINDING_1_THE_FLOOR_IS_WITHIN_PROCESS_AN.the_pleasing_part: The predeclaration's design intent — 'member 1 is the promoted nominal's own policy so the adopted estimator sits INSIDE the ensemble rather than being a sixth neighbour of it' — accidentally supplied the across-process control the floor lacked. It was chosen for a different reason and it is the only reason this is measurable.
FINDING_1_THE_FLOOR_IS_WITHIN_PROCESS_AN.STATED_LIMIT: n = 1 for BOTH floors — one nominal-vs-floor pair, one member1-vs-nominal pair. Neither is a distribution and neither carries an uncertainty. The 13.9x should not be read as more precise than a single difference of single differences.

FINDING_2_THREE_OF_FIVE_MEMBERS_EXCEED_T.what: validate_pet_nominal_gate4.py sets fold_forward_ratio_dev_max = 0.05 (status MEASURED_20260806_B1_48SEEDS_NITER3). Members 2 (0.1015), 4 (0.1802) and 5 (0.2465) exceed it. The promoted nominal itself is 0.0356 and passes.
FINDING_2_THREE_OF_FIVE_MEMBERS_EXCEED_T.not_adjudicated: That bar governs the NOMINAL, and no rule says an ensemble member must individually satisfy it. Whether a spread that carries three members past the nominal's own acceptance bar is 'estimator variation' or 'members that are not converged' is a physics judgement and is NOT made here.
FINDING_2_THREE_OF_FIVE_MEMBERS_EXCEED_T.related: the nominal's dev (0.0356) sits in the LOWER part of the member range (0.019–0.247); the ensemble mean dev is ~0.118. The predeclaration's PASS branch says the component is 'computed centred on the ensemble mean', so whether the adopted central should move is a live consequence of that sentence, not a detail.

COST_CORRECTION.predeclared: 'One member is one full-event training: 6:00:36 wall (sacct on 56563761). Five members ≈ 30 GPU node-hours.'
COST_CORRECTION.measured: each member took ~3:00, and the five totalled ~15:07 of wall across concurrent jobs, i.e. about half the predeclared budget.
COST_CORRECTION.why: 56563761's 6:00:36 covers TWO sequential trainings — the nominal (npz written 18:00:43Z, 3h01m in) and the matched same-seed repeat (npz written 21:00:17Z). The predeclaration took a two-training job's wall time as the cost of one training.
COST_CORRECTION.consequence: harmless here (the run came in under budget) but it is the same figure Gate 5's ~300 GPU node-hour estimate is built from, so that estimate is likely 2x high as well.

WHAT_IS_NOT_CLAIMED: No ML covariance component is computed or reported here. The predeclaration's PASS branch calls for one centred on the ensemble mean; that is a promotion step and it is not taken.
No statement that the members are or are not converged. Finding 2 records the fact and refuses the interpretation.
No claim that 13.9x rather than 1792x is the 'correct' margin in any adopted sense — only that the two floors measure different things and the predeclared comparison is not like-for-like.
Member 5's numerical output was not compared against members 1-4 for the code-identity split; the equivalence argument is a source diff, not an output comparison.
